annotation.kind: faithfulness rebuild of the computed CGS-P first-column residual identity and equation (16)

assumptions: The dimensions m and n are positive, n is at most m, and the rectangular input A has full column rank.

Q and upper-triangular R are the computed factors represented by the proof-carrying CGS-P first-column execution contract, with r11 linked to the computed norm and q1 linked to componentwise division.
Every leading block of R has a certified inverse and satisfies condition (3): c4(m,k)*epsilonM*kappa2(R_k)^2 < 1, where c4=c2+2*c1 and c1(m,k)=2*sqrt(2*m*k)+2*sqrt(k) for k at least two.

The machine unit epsilonM is positive and less than one; normalized IEEE division has relative error at most epsilonM, and the computed norm has the paper's first-order error plus one unspecified nonnegative O(epsilonM^2) coefficient.

The real-valued arithmetic interface represents the paper's IEEE normalized finite regime; subnormals, overflow, infinities, NaNs, and higher-order contributions outside the recorded norm remainder are outside the claim.

conditions.L: The identical fixed statement and P11 shared files are present; the frozen NumStability library is also present.
conditions.N: The fixed statement and P11 shared files are present; no NumStability artifact is present.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p11_t1_first_column_residual_action {m n : Nat} (run : P11CGSPFirstColumnRun m n) : P11Equation16 run
formal_statement.plain_language: For the computed first column of any admissible CGS-P run, derive the exact normalization and factorization-residual identities and the complete equation-(16) spectral/Euclidean norm chain ending at epsilonM times the input-column norm.

informal_proof: Use the normalized IEEE division law at each first-column entry to obtain relative errors delta_i with |delta_i|<=epsilonM. The diagonal matrix with entries delta_i has induced 2-norm at most epsilonM and witnesses q1=(I+G1)*a1/r11. Substitute this relation into A1-Q1*R1, cancel the positive computed r11, identify the one-column matrix norm with its Euclidean column norm, and apply the spectral operator-norm action bound.
informal_statement: The exact computed CGS-P first-column residual identity and complete induced-2-norm chain in equation (16).
